QuestInfo.0: Meet Professor Foxwit, the eccentric scientific genius the mayor referred you to.
QuestInfo.1: You meet Professor Foxwit, the eccentric scientific genius the mayor referred you to. While trying out his Signal Detector, you detect a girl's scream in the jungle. Something bad's probably going down, so venture into the jungle to find out what!
